text: Westport Albion’s strength in transitioning quickly from defense to attack was evident with Marek Zielinski's interception sparking a rapid 3-pass build-up over 16.9 seconds, culminating in a dangerous header from Jonah Valdez that required a fine save by Tariq Brennan [#1464][#1469][#1470][#1471]. Their direct, vertical passing style effectively exploited the spaces left by Kingsmoor FC’s wide, crossing-focused 4-4-2, which struggled to maintain defensive shape against swift central attacks. However, despite maintaining possession and high pass accuracy, Westport Albion risked conceding if their transitions are not capped with clinical finishing. Coaching point: emphasize defensive organization during quick transitions to reduce vulnerability in central areas when breaking forward rapidly.
